facts.text: Romazzino was founded by the Aga Khan IV and first opened its doors in the 1960s.
facts.excerpt: This was how Romazzino’s founder, The Aga Khan IV, described Costa Smeralda. When the doors first opened in the 1960’s

facts.text: The hotel's architecture is by Michele Busiri Vici.
The hotel has a private sandy beach with views of the La Maddalena archipelago.
facts.excerpt: Private sandy beach with views of La Maddalena archipelago

facts.text: The hotel has one seawater pool and one freshwater pool.
facts.excerpt: One seawater pool and one freshwater pool

facts.text: The hotel offers independent villas with dedicated pools.
Restaurant La Terrasse offers panoramic fine dining.
facts.excerpt: Panoramic fine dining at Restaurant La Terrasse

facts.text: Éntu e Mari is a relaxed beachside grill.
facts.excerpt: Éntu e Mari, a relaxed beachside grill

facts.text: The hotel has a spa called Romazzino Spa.
The hotel has an open-air gym and a Pilates studio.
The hotel has tennis and padel courts.
The hotel has a children's club.
The hotel is a 40-minute drive from Olbia Costa Smeralda Airport.
facts.excerpt: 40 min drive from Olbia Costa Smeralda Airport (OLB)

facts.text: The hotel hosts intimate ceremonial weddings and blessings, honeymoons and family celebrations.
